app.title.description: Navigation bar title of the Terminal Settings app.

app.unavailable.description: Shown in place of the page when the host has no terminal or refused to load its settings.

app.unavailableHint.defaultMessage: This app has to be opened from the host's own Terminal Settings.
app.unavailableHint.description: Under app.unavailable: what the person can do.

app.loading.description: Accessible name of the loading placeholder.

app.saveFailed.defaultMessage: Couldn't save this change. Try again.
app.saveFailed.description: Inline error under a setting whose write failed.

app.warning.defaultMessage: Some saved settings could not be used
app.warning.description: Title of the banner listing problems with the saved settings file; the host's sentences follow.

appearance.title.description: Heading of the color scheme section.

appearance.scheme.description: Accessible name of the group of color scheme cards.

appearance.slot.light.description: Slot used while the product is light.

appearance.slot.dark.description: Slot used while the product is dark.

appearance.slot.inUse.description: Caption when the chosen slot is the one the terminal shows.

appearance.slot.usedLight.defaultMessage: Used when the product is light.
appearance.slot.usedLight.description: Caption for the light slot while dark is in use.

appearance.slot.usedDark.defaultMessage: Used when the product is dark.
appearance.slot.usedDark.description: Caption for the dark slot while light is in use.

appearance.empty.defaultMessage: No schemes for this appearance yet. Import one.
appearance.empty.description: Shown when no scheme matches the current appearance.

appearance.import.description: Button that opens a file picker to import a color scheme file.

appearance.importName.description: Accessible description of the import button.

appearance.imported.description: Toast after a scheme file was imported. name = the scheme's name.

appearance.importInvalid.defaultMessage: That file isn't a color scheme. Use a Windows Terminal JSON scheme, or kitty or Xresources color lines.
appearance.importInvalid.description: Error after importing a file that is not a scheme.

appearance.importExists.defaultMessage: A scheme with that name is already installed.
appearance.importExists.description: Error after importing a scheme whose name is taken.

appearance.importFailed.description: Error after importing failed for another reason.

appearance.builtIn.description: Source of a scheme that ships with the product.

appearance.importedSource.description: Source of a scheme the user imported.

appearance.card.description: Accessible name of a scheme card. name = scheme name, source = Built in, Imported or its author.

type.family.description: Label of the font family picker.

type.familyMissing.defaultMessage: {family} isn't installed, so the terminal uses {fallback}.
type.familyMissing.description: Under Font family when the chosen font is missing. family = requested, fallback = drawn.

type.size.description: Label of the font size field.

type.sizeName.description: Accessible name of the font size field.

type.sizeUnit.description: Unit after the font size number: points.

type.sizeRange.description: Error when the font size field is empty or out of range.

type.smaller.description: Accessible name of the font size minus stepper.

type.larger.description: Accessible name of the font size plus stepper.

type.lineHeight.description: Label of the line height slider.

type.lineHeightHint.defaultMessage: Multiplier for the font's natural line height.

type.lineHeightValue.description: Line height value, e.g. 1.2×. value = the multiplier.

windows.inlineImages.description: Label of the Windows inline images switch.

windows.inlineImagesHint.defaultMessage: Download Microsoft's optional compatibility runtime so Kitty images reach the terminal unchanged. New tabs and panes use it immediately.

windows.downloading.description: Label of the runtime download progress bar.

windows.downloadingAmount.description: Download amount, e.g. 1.2 MB of 3.4 MB.

windows.megabytes.description: A size in megabytes. value = the number.

windows.failed.defaultMessage: Couldn't change inline images. Try again.
windows.failed.description: Inline error when the switch could not be changed.

reset.hint.defaultMessage: Drops every override and returns to what this product ships.

reset.action.description: Button that asks to reset every terminal setting.

reset.confirmTitle.description: Title of the reset confirmation dialog.

reset.confirmMessage.defaultMessage: Your font, size, line height, ligatures and color schemes go back to what this product ships. Imported schemes stay installed.
reset.confirmMessage.description: Body of the reset confirmation dialog.

reset.confirm.description: Destructive button in the reset dialog.
